tagline: A 700-island nation built for island-hopping — and the closest international archipelago to a major US city.
summary: The Bahamas is 700+ islands and 2,000+ cays spread across 100,000 sq mi of shallow banks, anchored by Nassau/Paradise Island and reaching south to the Exumas and east to Eleuthera and the Abacos. Tourism is the economy, and the high-value out-islands (Exuma cays, Harbour Island, the Abacos) are reached today by a flight-plus-boat, a long mailboat, or a seaplane — exactly the pain Navier removes. Nassau is also ~150 nm from Miami and Bimini is ~48 nm, making the Bahamas the natural international extension of the Miami beachhead.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the Nassau-radius hops: Harbour Island/Eleuthera (~50 nm), North-Exuma cays (~35 nm), and Bimini↔Miami (~48 nm).
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) makes the long banks crossings routine: the full Exuma chain to George Town (~115 nm), the Abacos (~110 nm), and Miami↔Nassau (~150 nm) — with diesel refuel removing any out-island charging dependency.

competitive_landscape: Bahamas Ferries (fast ferry + mailboat), seaplane operators (Tropic Ocean, Makers Air), and a fragmented charter fleet move people today — all demand proof and partnering candidates. There is no foiling incumbent; the pain is reliability, comfort, and the universal flight-plus-boat relay.
seasonality: Atlantic hurricane season (Jun–Nov, peak Aug–Oct) is the binding constraint; mid-Dec–mid-Apr is peak season and calmest. The shallow banks are protected in many areas, but the deep-water crossings (Exuma Sound, Florida Straits, NE Providence Channel) drive the Quanta-LR case.
regulatory_note: The Bahamas Maritime Authority is one of the world's leading flag registries — a fast, sophisticated certification counterpart. CBP/immigration pre-clearance for the Miami corridor; clean-fleet positioning aligns with the Exuma Land & Sea Park (a protected marine area).
